name: BeeTea's Fairy Corner
source:
A visual novel + boba shop simulator where the player plays beside Poppy Pearl, the owner of BeeTea’s newly founded Fairy Corner. Figure out and fulfill the orders of the fairy clientele that visit the establishment for a break from their busy lives!

[From [url=https://spicypineneedles.itch.io/fairycorner]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款融合了珍珠奶茶店模拟经营玩法的视觉小说，玩家将陪伴“蜜茶坊”新设分店“仙子茶角”的店主波比·珀尔一同打理店铺。摸清并制作出各位小仙子顾客心仪的饮品订单，为在忙碌生活中偷得浮生半日闲的她们奉上一杯好茶吧！

[摘自[url=https://spicypineneedles.itch.io/fairycorner]itch.io[/url]]
